answer: Require every identity to post a refundable work-bond before its answers can be judged. The bond unlocks only after a trellis of independent juries accepts N non-duplicate work items over several epochs, with one tranche maturing per epoch. A thousand sockpuppets therefore lock a thousand bonds for a long delay. If a later panel flags cloned text or correlated grades, the bond is slashed and sibling accounts on the same referrer path are frozen. A coat of umber metadata or a reef of throwaway posts cannot shrink that lockup or skip the unlock clock, so each fake head costs time-locked capital.
